title: OrientationFrame
description: Project-level north and latitude. Cardinals on openings are derived from host-edge outward normals relative to north. Equator-ward is -north when latitude_deg > 0, +north when latitude_deg < 0, and undefined when latitude_deg is 0.

north.description: Plan-plane unit vector toward geographic north (TrueNorth).

latitude_deg.description: Site latitude. Zero makes equator-ward undefined.

derivation.description: Opening orientation is the axis-aligned cardinal of the host footprint edge outward normal, classified against north.
